title: Weighted ergodic averages along subpolynomials in Hardy fields and applications
summary: We establish new pointwise convergence results for weighted ergodic averages along sequences of the form \( (\lfloor a(n) \rfloor)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}, \) where $a(x)$ is a subpolynomial function in a Hardy field. For example, we establish pointwise convergence of logarithmic averages along sequences of the form $(\lfloor n^k + \log^{c} n \rfloor)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$, where $k \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{0\}$ and $c > 0$.
